<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&#160;</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000436" name="us-gaap:CommitmentsAndContingenciesDisclosureTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001361983_20190101_20191231" escape="true">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Note&#160;14.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Commitments and Contingencies </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Legal Proceedings</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">From time to time, the Company is involved in various litigation matters involving claims incidental to its business and acquisitions, including employment matters, acquisition related claims, patent infringement and contractual matters, among other issues. While the outcome of any such litigation matters cannot be predicted with certainty, management currently believes that the outcome of these proceedings, including the matters described below, either individually or in the aggregate, will not have a material adverse effect on its business, results of operations or financial condition. The Company records reserves related to legal matters when losses related to such litigation or contingencies are both probable and reasonably estimable.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Airtime credits </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In 2001, in connection with the organization of ORBCOMM Europe and the reorganization of the ORBCOMM business in Europe, the Company agreed to grant certain country representatives in Europe approximately $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001231" name="orbc:CreditProvided" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtStatementGeographicalAxis_srtEuropeMember_us-gaapCreditFacilityAxis_orbcProcurementAgreementMember_us-gaapLongTermPurchaseCommitmentByCategoryOfItemPurchasedAxis_orbcAirtimeMember_20010101_20011231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">3,736</ix:nonFraction> in airtime credits. The Company has not recorded the airtime credits as a liability for the following reasons: (i)&#160;the Company has no obligation to pay the unused airtime credits if they are not utilized&#59; and (ii)&#160;the airtime credits are earned by the country representatives only when the Company generates revenue from the country representatives. The airtime credits have no expiration date. Accordingly, the Company is recording airtime credits as services are rendered and these airtime credits are recorded net of revenues from the country representatives. As of December&#160;31, 2019 and 2018, unused credits granted by the Company were approximately $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001235" name="orbc:UnusedCreditsGranted" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtStatementGeographicalAxis_srtEuropeMember_us-gaapCreditFacilityAxis_orbcProcurementAgreementMember_us-gaapLongTermPurchaseCommitmentByCategoryOfItemPurchasedAxis_orbcAirtimeMember_20191231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">1,918</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001236" name="orbc:UnusedCreditsGranted" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtStatementGeographicalAxis_srtEuropeMember_us-gaapCreditFacilityAxis_orbcProcurementAgreementMember_us-gaapLongTermPurchaseCommitmentByCategoryOfItemPurchasedAxis_orbcAirtimeMember_20181231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">1,948</ix:nonFraction>, respectively. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Agreements with carrier data providers </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company has contractual minimum payments under the terms of its agreements with certain carrier data providers. Based on the number of subscribers as of December 31, 2019, future minimum payments for the years ending December&#160;31, 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2023 are $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001237" name="us-gaap:ContractualObligationDueInNextTwelveMonths" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtCounterpartyNameAxis_orbcCarrierDataProvidersMember_20191231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">8,091</ix:nonFraction>, $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001238" name="us-gaap:ContractualObligationDueInSecondYear" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtCounterpartyNameAxis_orbcCarrierDataProvidersMember_20191231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">5,944</ix:nonFraction>, $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001239" name="us-gaap:ContractualObligationDueInThirdYear" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtCounterpartyNameAxis_orbcCarrierDataProvidersMember_20191231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">6,093</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001240" name="us-gaap:ContractualObligationDueInFourthYear" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtCounterpartyNameAxis_orbcCarrierDataProvidersMember_20191231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">6,245</ix:nonFraction>, respectively. </p></ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000437" name="orbc:LesseeOperatingLeasesAndLessorSalesTypeLeasesTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001361983_20190101_20191231" escape="true" continuedAt="F_000437_dcnt_919d61a4-d598-4e96-be4a-a5417789810b">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Note 15. Leases</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In February 2016, the FASB issued ASU 2016-02, which is effective for fiscal years beginning after December 15, 2018. The Company adopted ASU 2016-02 prospectively as of January 1, 2019, the date of initial application, and therefore prior comparative periods were not adjusted. Rent expense for the years ended December 31, 2018 and 2017 was approximately $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001241" name="us-gaap:LeaseAndRentalExpense" contextRef="C_0001361983_20180101_20181231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">4,020</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001242" name="us-gaap:LeaseAndRentalExpense" contextRef="C_0001361983_20170101_20171231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">3,401</ix:nonFraction>, respectively, and was recognized on a straight-line basis over the lease term under ASC Topic 840 &#8220;Leases.&#8221;</p></ix:nonNumeric>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">F-34</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p><ix:continuation id="F_000437_dcnt_919d61a4-d598-4e96-be4a-a5417789810b" continuedAt="F_000437_dcnt_b0e25f1b-5cb2-4cec-8d0b-630bb996268d">
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.5%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Lessee</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company determines whether an arrangement is a lease at inception. The Company has operating leases for land, office space, data centers and storage facilities, as well as office equipment and vehicles. The Company&#8217;s leases have remaining lease terms of less than <ix:nonNumeric id="F_001243" name="orbc:LesseeOperatingLeaseRemainingLeaseTerm" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtRangeAxis_srtMinimumMember_20190101_20191231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">one year</ix:nonNumeric> to <ix:nonNumeric id="F_001244" name="orbc:LesseeOperatingLeaseRemainingLeaseTerm" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_20190101_20191231" format="ixt-sec:duryear">13</ix:nonNumeric> years, some of which include options to extend the lease term for up to <ix:nonNumeric id="F_001245" name="us-gaap:LesseeOperatingLeaseRenewalTerm" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_20191231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">five years</ix:nonNumeric>, and some of which include options to terminate the lease within <ix:nonNumeric id="F_001246" name="orbc:LesseeOperatingLeasesOptionsToTerminateLeaseTerm" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_20190101_20191231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">one year</ix:nonNumeric>. The Company considered these options in determining the lease term used to establish the Company&#8217;s right-of use assets and lease liabilities. The Company&#8217;s lease agreements do not contain any material residual value guarantees or material restrictive covenants.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Right-of-use (&#8220;ROU&#8221;) assets represent the Company&#8217;s right to use an underlying asset for the lease term and lease liabilities represent the Company&#8217;s obligation to make lease payments arising from the lease. Operating lease ROU assets and operating lease liabilities are recognized at the lease commencement date based on the present value of the future lease payments over the lease term. The operating lease ROU assets also include any lease payments made in advance of lease commencements and exclude lease incentives. The lease terms used in the calculations of the operating ROU assets and operating lease liabilities include options to extend or terminate the lease when the Company is reasonably certain that it will exercise those options. Lease expense for lease payments is recognized on a straight-line basis over the lease term.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">As the Company&#8217;s leases do not provide an implicit rate, the Company uses its incremental borrowing rate based on the information available at commencement date in determining the present value of lease payments.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company has lease agreements with lease and non-lease components, which are generally not accounted for separately.</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000500" name="us-gaap:LeaseCostTableTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001361983_20190101_20191231" escape="true">

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.5%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Lessor</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Although most of the Company&#8217;s revenue from its product sales comes from the sale of subscriber communicators, the Company also leases some subscriber communicators to certain customers. The Company determines the existence of a lease when the customer controls the use of the identified product for a period of time defined in the lease agreement. The Company&#8217;s leases range in duration between three to <ix:nonNumeric id="F_001268" name="us-gaap:LessorSalesTypeLeaseTermOfContract1" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_20191231" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen">five years</ix:nonNumeric>, with payment generally collected in monthly installments. Refer to &#8220;Note 2 &#8211; Summary of Significant Accounting Policies&#8221; for more information.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company classifies these leases as sales-type leases and recognizes revenue and cost of product sales upon delivery or installation, depending on the specific contractual terms. The Company&#8217;s leases include certain termination fees, as defined in the lease agreements, and do not typically include purchase rights at the end of the lease.&#160;&#160;</p></ix:continuation>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&#160;</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000438" name="us-gaap:CompensationAndEmployeeBenefitPlansTextBlock" contextRef="C_0001361983_20190101_20191231" escape="true">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:9pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Note&#160;16.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Employee Incentive Plan </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company maintains a 401(k) plan. All employees who have been employed for three months or longer are eligible to participate in the plan. Employees may contribute up to <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_001269" name="us-gaap:DefinedContributionPlanMaximumAnnualContributionsPerEmployeePercent" contextRef="C_0001361983_20190101_20191231" decimals="INF" scale="-2">15</ix:nonFraction>% of eligible compensation to the plan, subject to certain limitations. The Company has the option of matching up to <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_001270" name="us-gaap:DefinedContributionPlanEmployerMatchingContributionPercentOfMatch" contextRef="C_0001361983_srtRangeAxis_srtMaximumMember_20190101_20191231" decimals="2" scale="-2">50</ix:nonFraction>% of the amount contributed by each employee, up to <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_001271" name="us-gaap:DefinedContributionPlanEmployerMatchingContributionPercent" contextRef="C_0001361983_20190101_20191231" decimals="2" scale="-2">6</ix:nonFraction>% of the employee&#8217;s compensation. In addition, the plan contains a discretionary contribution component pursuant to which the Company may make an additional annual contribution. Contributions vest over a <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:F_001272">five-year</span> period from the employee&#8217;s date of employment. For the years ended December&#160;31, 2019, 2018 and 2017, the Company made contributions of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001273" name="us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanContributionsByEmployer" contextRef="C_0001361983_20190101_20191231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">1,189</ix:nonFraction>, $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001274" name="us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanContributionsByEmployer" contextRef="C_0001361983_20180101_20181231" decimals="-3" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" scale="3">1,104</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_001275" name="us-gaap:DefinedBenefitPlanContributionsByEmployer" contextRef="C_0001361983_20170101_20171231" decimals="-3" scale="3">766</ix:nonFraction>, respectively. </p></ix:nonNumeric>
